blocks.text: DNA ki banawat daryaft hone (1953) aur central dogma pesh hone (1957) ke baad mahireen ne poocha ke sirf chaar qisam ke nucleotides wala DNA hazaron mukhtalif proteins ki maloomat kaise rakh sakta hai, genetic code ki noeeyat kya hai, aur nucleotides ki tarteeb amino acids ki tarteeb kaise tay karti hai.

1961 mein Crick aur us ke saathiyon ne kaha ke genetic code maloomat ke tukron, codons, ka silsila hai, har aik aik amino acid tay karta hai. Aik nucleotide fi amino acid sirf 4 amino acids aur do nucleotides sirf 16 (4 x 4) ka code de sakte, is liye codon teen nucleotides ka hona chahiye: 4 x 4 x 4 = 64 milap, 20 amino acids ke liye kaafi se zyada. Is liye code triplet code hai.

Jab gene kaam karta hai to DNA ke codons mRNA ke complementary codons mein transcribe hote hain, yaani DNA triplet TAC mRNA codon AUG ban jata hai. 'Codon' aam taur par mRNA codon hai, lekin kabhi DNA triplets ke liye bhi bola jata hai, khaas kar mutations ki baat mein.
Nirenberg, Leder aur Khorana ka kaam

1961 mein American biochemist Marshall Nirenberg ne sirf uracil nucleotides ka poly-U mRNA banaya aur bacteria ke cytoplasm mein dala; bohat se phenylalanines ka polypeptide bana, yaani UUU phenylalanine ka code hai. Nirenberg aur American mahir-e-genetics Philip Leder ne triplets jaanch kar 47 codons ke amino acids tay kiye; Har Gobind Khorana ne, jinhon ne Government College, Lahore se taleem mukammal ki, baqi 17 tay kiye.

items: 64 codons mein UGA, UAG aur UAA stop (nonsense) codons hain: koi amino acid nahi dete aur protein banana khatam karte hain.
AUG genes ke shuru mein start codon hai; yeh methionine ka code deta hai.

blocks.title: Maloomat
blocks.text: Proteins banane ke liye DNA ki maloomat genetic code hai, teen nucleotides ke codons ka silsila. 1968 ka Physiology ya Medicine ka Nobel Prize Nirenberg (genetic code), Khorana (nucleic acids ki tayyari) aur Robert Holley (transfer RNA ki kimiyai banawat) ko mila.

blocks.prompt: Agar DNA template triplet AAA ho to mRNA codon aur amino acid kya hai?
blocks.explanation: mRNA codon UUU hai jo phenylalanine ka code hai (Nirenberg ka poly-U nateeja).

items: Crick (1961): triplet codons; 20 amino acids ke liye 64 codons.
Nirenberg: UUU = phenylalanine; Nirenberg aur Leder 47 codons, Khorana 17.
AUG start (Met); UAA, UAG, UGA stop.
